name: Office Ally
short_description: Office Ally is a free clearinghouse and practice management platform for small healthcare practices with no per-claim fees.
long_description: Office Ally is a healthcare technology company offering free clearinghouse services and affordable practice management software. The platform provides free claims submission to participating payers with no per-claim fees, making it popular among solo practitioners and small mental health practices. Office Ally also offers a practice management system called Practice Mate and an EHR called EHR 24/7 at low cost. The company has been providing free claims processing since 2000 and serves over 200,000 healthcare providers.
one_liner: Free clearinghouse and practice management for small healthcare practices.
best_for: Solo practitioners and small practices billing primarily commercial payers
Mental health practices seeking a no-cost clearinghouse option
Providers who need a complete practice management suite with billing
Practices wanting to avoid per-claim fees for participating payers
